scope: durable-approval-outbox history, its recompute-isolated descendant, and Phase 14 controlled agent ablations

operators.name: Move external truth outside the subject's authority
operators.changed: The tool ledger moved to a root-owned service; scenario execution moved to an unprivileged process; collection no longer imports the engine; positive execution checks and cheat oracles were added.
operators.stayedFixed: The durable-outbox behavior being requested and the exactly-once mechanism.
operators.beforeEvidence: A no-tool engine and a buggy engine that rebound tool.calls each passed 113/113.
operators.afterEvidence: The corrected oracle/reference passed 267/267; no-op, empty-ledger and ledger-rebind oracles all received reward 0.
operators.fairnessOutcome: improved: a reward now requires the external work the task asks for, without adding a hidden behavior rule
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: closed three demonstrated bypasses: vacuous success, same-process ground-truth rewrite, and decorative database-role isolation

solveRateEffect.note: The old perfect scores were verifier bypasses, not comparable agent solves. This operator repairs validity and must not be credited as hardness.

operators.capabilityAttribution: not-applicable: this repairs what reward means

operators.name: State the terminal ACKED rule explicitly
operators.changed: One visible sentence: ACKED and REVOKED are terminal and have no outgoing transition.
operators.stayedFixed: Task implementation, harness, verifier, scenarios, starter, agent instruction and all other visible text; task name differed for arm identity.
operators.beforeEvidence: Control: 2/6 clean solves; 33 failing cells were ACKED->REVOKED illegal transitions.
operators.afterEvidence: Treatment: 3/6 clean solves; 0 ACKED->REVOKED illegal-transition failures.
operators.fairnessOutcome: improved: moved the derivation from demanding A2 to explicit A3 and removed that wording axis from the descendant

solveRateEffect.note: The measured causal effect is the disappearance of 33 target failures, not a claim that every reward difference came from the sentence.

operators.capabilityAttribution: negative for the repaired axis: wording carried the target failures

operators.name: Recover a committed idempotency key across lease epochs
operators.changed: The correct implementation persists one action-stable key before calling the tool and recovers that value after uncertain completion instead of deriving from current lease state.
operators.stayedFixed: The external operation, action identity, payload, tool idempotency behavior and retry requirement.
operators.beforeEvidence: A recomputed epoch key creates two ledger effects for one action while each invocation returns OK.
operators.afterEvidence: A recovered committed key creates one ledger effect and later calls receive an OK deduplication receipt.
operators.fairnessOutcome: passes: the committed value exists before the crash and is available to a correct implementation
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: requires grading on an external per-action ledger rather than on subject status

solveRateEffect.before: 8/8 clean passes on paired non-activation/control views
solveRateEffect.after: 8/8 clean passes on paired recompute-target views
solveRateEffect.note: Phase 14 E3 measured a paired descriptive target-minus-control failure effect of 0.000; scenario rows are not independent trials.

operators.capabilityAttribution: no positive effect established: all eight countable Phase 14 submissions passed both paired views, so no root-cause labels ran

operators.name: Fuzz for the controlling activation parameter
operators.changed: Selection moved from broad schedules chosen against one buggy engine to a parameter grid followed by selection in the region that reliably activates the target mechanism.
operators.stayedFixed: Agent-visible package, mechanism, reference, verifier rules and subject bank used for anti-overfitting checks.
operators.beforeEvidence: The 245-check suite produced 5/6 failures and missed a solved engine carrying the target ACKED bug; the old four points caught 4-5 measured engines each.
operators.afterEvidence: Six replacement key_index=0 points caught 6-7 engines each, including 5-6 not used for selection; the unchanged visible task then produced 6/6 failures.
operators.fairnessOutcome: unchanged: only hidden coverage of an existing declared rule changed
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: improved activation validity; a candidate whose reference event did not fire was rejected

solveRateEffect.note: The two matrices used different fresh subjects, so this is an artifact-level outcome change, not an individual treatment effect.

operators.capabilityAttribution: not-established under the foundry's blind-labelling rule

operators.name: Concentrate recompute recovery on multi-worker schedules
operators.changed: The descendant selects two seeds per (n_workers, keys) cell after a completed uncertain call, with explicit one-worker and no-crash controls.
operators.stayedFixed: Repaired specification, reference, verifier and narrow recompute defect.
operators.beforeEvidence: n_workers=1 activated 0/24 runs; the repaired parent separated the narrow defect on 3/24 instances.
operators.afterEvidence: n_workers=2 and 3 activated 45.8% and 58.3% in the grid; the selected descendant region separated 105/108 points and its selected 18 schedules caught the narrow mutant 18/18.
operators.fairnessOutcome: passes: selection changes probability of reaching a published recovery case, not the rule
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: adds explicit non-activation controls so parameter effect cannot be inferred from an all-fail rig

solveRateEffect.before: 8/8 clean solves under the balanced rescore
solveRateEffect.note: Phase 14 E4 is a paired descriptive rescore of the same eight agent artifacts, not eight new independent contrasts; measured effect 0.000.

operators.capabilityAttribution: no positive effect established: all eight countable Phase 14 submissions passed both target and control views, so no root-cause labels ran

operators.name: Measure one defect against an otherwise identical reference
operators.changed: One policy switch changes committed-key recovery to current-epoch recomputation.
operators.stayedFixed: All other reference behavior, calls, reports, payloads and harness behavior.
operators.beforeEvidence: Broadly buggy engines made it impossible to tell which defect caused separation.
operators.afterEvidence: Corrected Phase 9 rig: reference failed 0/18 and the narrow recompute mutant failed 18/18.
operators.fairnessOutcome: improved diagnosis: the result is attributed only to the intended defect
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: positive, subject to the B6 correction recorded separately

solveRateEffect.note: Mutant fatality is verifier evidence, not solve-rate evidence.

operators.name: Run known-good, known-bad and malformed-input controls with every rig
operators.changed: Every new pass/fail rig must prove the reference passes, a targeted bad subject fails, and absent or wrong-shaped evidence is refused in the same invocation.
operators.stayedFixed: The measured subject behavior and verifier rules.
operators.beforeEvidence: A Phase 9 rig attached result.tool while checks read result._tool, making the correct reference appear to fail 18/18.
operators.afterEvidence: The corrected rig passed reference 18/18 and failed the narrow mutant 18/18; Phase 10 added B6/screen 9 and this package runs it internally.
operators.fairnessOutcome: improved: broken apparatus produces a void run instead of a false subject failure
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: directly detects inverted controls, degenerate uncalibrated results and missing input shape

solveRateEffect.note: This prevents fabricated measurement; it does not make a task harder.

operators.name: Seed the public starter with the natural recomputation error
operators.changed: The starter implements the tempting current-epoch derivation but leaves the repair to the agent.
operators.stayedFixed: The complete repaired specification, committed key in the public view and submission interface.
operators.beforeEvidence: Legacy starter profiles were not represented as a construction variable.
operators.afterEvidence: The packaged starter fails all 18 activated schedules and passes non-activation controls through the real trial route.
operators.fairnessOutcome: passes locally: the starter is explicitly labelled wrong and the correct value is visible in every input
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: none; the starter is graded by the same sealed ledgers as every submission

solveRateEffect.before: 2/2 clean solves with the neutral DAO starter
solveRateEffect.after: 2/2 clean solves with the seeded recompute DAO starter
solveRateEffect.note: Phase 14 E2 measured a 0.000 matched reward-zero contrast across OpenAI and Anthropic; one attempt per cell limits causal precision.

operators.capabilityAttribution: no positive effect established: all four DAO attempts solved, so no failure required root-cause labelling

operators.name: Grade a behavioural obligation from the counterparty's record, not from the submitted source
operators.changed: The requirement that several rechecks be in flight together is checked against the authority's own root-owned append-only tick-stamped log of when each query started and finished, rather than against anything visible in the submission.
operators.stayedFixed: The published contract (SEMANTICS.md section 3) and the defect the task asks the agent to repair.
operators.beforeEvidence: The claim that a repair which fixes identifier pairing by deleting the goroutines would still be rejected was asserted during construction and never tested.
operators.afterEvidence: Two pairing-correct variants were built and graded. `serial-repair` (fan-out deleted, queries issued sequentially) scored 24/24 scenarios failed on both frozen suites, reward 0. `mutex-serialized` (goroutines retained, a mutex held across the query so the fan-out is cosmetic) failed identically, 24/24 on both suites, reward 0. Both fail only `rechecks_issued_together`, and only on the scenarios carrying two or more pending identifiers. The reference passes 0/24 failed on both suites.
operators.fairnessOutcome: fair: the obligation is published verbatim in SEMANTICS.md section 3 ('An order carrying several identifiers to recheck costs one authority round trip, not one per identifier: their rechecks are in flight together') and restated in instruction.md, and checks.py maps the check to that section. This is stated-and-enforced, not a grader scoring unpublished behaviour.
operators.verifierIntegrityEffect: closed the degenerate repair route. Because the check reads observed overlap at the counterparty rather than the shape of the submitted code, a submission cannot satisfy it by merely looking concurrent - the mutex variant keeps every goroutine and still fails.

solveRateEffect.note: This operator was part of the Phase 18 bundle, which was applied all at once and produced 3 of 3 clean solves at time of writing. It closed a shortcut; it did not measurably make the task hard. It must not be credited with hardness.

operators.capabilityAttribution: not-applicable: this constrains what a passing repair must actually do, it does not attribute difficulty to a capability
